purpose: Test whether one official IEBC Form 34B image-scan can yield a sufficiently legible machine transcription to justify a separate governed extraction pipeline. This contract does not authorise turnout materialization.

known_source_state.implication: A source-image transcription step is required if Form 34B is to be used for numeric turnout materialization.

feasibility_checks: The downloaded file remains an official IEBC PDF for the governed sample form ID.
The page count remains three for the governed sample.
OCR is run only against the sample during this gate; no 290-form bulk transcription is authorised.
The OCR output contains meaningful alphabetic and numeric content rather than an empty or near-empty transcript.
Relevant election-form concepts can be located in the transcript with usable OCR confidence.
No OCR-derived integer is promoted to the canonical registry by this probe.
promotion_rule: Passing this sample gate only authorises design of a separate reproducible extraction-and-verification pipeline. Canonical turnout still requires source-level verification of registered voters, total valid votes and rejected ballots for every promoted constituency, denominator reconciliation and all P23 turnout acceptance checks.
prohibited: bulk OCR promotion from this probe
silent correction of OCR values to expected totals
using candidate/media/citizen tallies as substitutes for official Form 34B
closing any IND-TURNOUT-HISTORY slot from sample-only evidence
